metadata.case_name: TANG SHU SHEK v. LEUNG CHI KIT AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: I find that the Plaintiff fractured his left scaphoid as a result of the accident.
source: I find that the Plaintiff fractured his left scaphoid as a result of the accident.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of scaphoid bone of hand

injuries.description: diagnostic arthroscopy of his left wrist, the result of which revealed degenerative changes of the Plaintiff's scaphoid and mild synovities of his radio carpal joint.
source: diagnostic arthroscopy of his left wrist, the result of which revealed degenerative changes of the Plaintiff's scaphoid and mild synovities of his radio carpal joint.

manifestations.description: The Plaintiff is only left with a mild reduction of strength and residual pain.
the Plaintiff's injured wrist had a mild reduction in extension and ulnar radiation
Tenderness over the scaphoid and lunate
he still felt pain when he moved his left hand in an upward direction (radial flexion)
local tenderness at the dorsum of the left wrist

treatments_received: discharged on the same day with analgesics
diagnostic arthroscopy of his left wrist in April 2000
physiotherapy treatment on about 40 occasions including heat therapy and active wrist mobilization, until March 2001

losses.description: The Plaintiff is only left with a mild reduction of strength and residual pain.
